text: A theory should also risk being wrong, so the atlas makes predictions a training run can test. Under Adam, a fair LoRA-plus baseline should multiply alpha by lambda. LoRA's charge should drift by a second-order amount per step of SGD, a cheap diagnostic of what your optimizer adds. <short pause> And it marks its own limits. Reaching a weight isn't the same as learning it. Most results are about images, in exact arithmetic. And words like gauge and Noether are analogies; the paper says exactly where each one stops.
